COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
SPA No.230 of 2022
Shri Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Shri Ramesh Chandra Khulbe, J.
Mr. V.K. Kaparuwan, learned counsel 
for the appellant.
Issue notice both on the delay 
condonation application (IA No.2 of 2022) 
and the appeal.
Mr. S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for 
respondent no.1 and Mr.S.S. Chauhan, 
learned Deputy Advocate General for the 
State/respondent nos.2 & 3 appear and 
accept notice. 
List for consideration on 15.03.2023. 
In the meantime, we direct the 
appellant to comply with the impugned 
judgment, considering the fact that 
respondent no.1 has been recognized by 
the State Government as Freedom Fighter 
and has been granted pension after 
verification of his documents; the State 
Government had recommended the case 
of the respondent no.1 for grant of 
Central Pension; the respondent no.1 is 
stated to be 102 years and is need of 
financial support; and the appellant did 
not participate to contest during the writ 
proceedings despite being the party; and 
the present appeal has been preferred 
belatedly. 
(R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
 18.10.2022
AK/BS
